clipBoardError: Unable to access the clipboard. Please grant clipboard permission or copy the content again.
settingsNotebookDesc: Notebook where new notes are created. Required before saving notes.
settingsInboxDirDesc: Document path inside the notebook where new notes are created. For nested paths use: Directory A/Directory B. Empty creates notes in notebook root.
settingsAssetsDirDesc: Workspace assets directory where downloaded images are stored. Usually 'assets'.
settingsOpenNewNoteDesc: If enabled, the new note will be opened after creation
settingsOpenNewNoteInNewTab: Open new note in new tab
settingsOpenNewNoteInNewTabDesc: If enabled, the new note will be opened in a new tab
settingsFileExistsStrategyDesc: Applied when a note with the same title already exists
settingsBatchDelimiterDesc: Delimiter for batch list of notes
settingsDateFormatDesc: Format of the date variable used in titles. NOTE: do not use symbols forbidden in file names.
settingsDateFormatContentDesc: Format of the date variable used in content
settingsYoutubeApiKeyDesc: If entered, Youtube related content types will use Youtube API to fetch the data.
settingsTemplateVarsRef: See the template variables reference in the plugin README
settingsFsLimitPathDesc: Leave empty to use the default limit. Default: {default}.
settingsFsLimitFileNameDesc: Leave empty to use the default limit. Default: {default}.
settingsReloadRequired: Change saved. Takes effect on next use.
downloadImagesDesc: Images will be downloaded to the workspace assets directory.
downloadImagesInDirDesc: Images will be downloaded to a dedicated note assets directory. Overrides assets directory template.
downloadAttachmentsInDir: Download media attachments to note directory
downloadEmbeddedInDir: Download embedded content to note directory
saveRepliesDesc: If enabled, replies will be saved.
embedPrivacyDesc: If enabled, content will be embedded in privacy enhanced mode, which prevents the use of views of it from influencing the viewer’s browsing experience on YouTube.
settingsImageBedToggleDesc: Upload clipped resources to your image bed instead of the workspace assets directory.
settingsImageBedUrlDesc: Base URL used for uploads, e.g. https://imgbed.example.com. Required when enabled.
settingsImageBedTokenDesc: Optional Bearer token if your image bed requires authentication.
settingsImageBedResources: Resources uploaded to the image bed
settingsImageBedResourcesDesc: Only resources of the selected categories are uploaded. Extensions listed under Custom are always uploaded.
settingsImageBedCustomExtDesc: Comma-separated extensions uploaded regardless of category, e.g. apk, zip, psd.
settingsImageBedLinkUrlDesc: Optional. Prefix for the links written into notes when upload and public origins differ (e.g. http internal upload vs https public). Empty falls back to the upload URL.
imgbedCheckNotEnabled: Please enable the image bed first.
imgbedCheckNoUrl: Please fill in the image bed upload URL first.
imgbedCheckOk: Image bed connection is working. The probe file has been cleaned up.
imgbedCheckCleanupFailed: Image bed connection is working. Probe cleanup failed — please delete {name} from the image bed.
settingsImageBedCheckDesc: Upload a probe file to verify the image bed is reachable.
dockDesc: Clip web content from the clipboard into your inbox notebook.
pasteFallbackDesc: The clipboard cannot be read automatically in this context. Paste your content below (Ctrl/Cmd+V) and click Clip.
